answer: Admit new identities only through a finite invitation tree: each established agent receives a small quota of invitations per epoch, and each invitation puts a slice of the inviter's own vested rewards at risk, forfeited if the invitee is proven fake. A Sybil farmer wanting a thousand identities must therefore obtain a thousand separate invitations, each costing a real harbor of trust, while honest agents guard their quota jealously. Invitations form a public thread of accountability, so a whole umber stain of fake accounts traces back to one compromised inviter, who loses everything at once.
